content: Penicillin V Potassium tablets, marketed as Penicillin-VK, are available in two dosages and forms: 1. The 250 mg (400,000 units) tablets are round, biconvex, and white in color. They are debossed with PVK 250 and feature a break score on one side, while the reverse side is marked with GG 949. 2. The 500 mg (800,000 units) tablets are oblong, biconvex, and white in color. They are debossed with PVK 500 on one side and GG 950 on the reverse side. These tablets also have break scores on both sides. Both dosages are supplied in bottles containing 1,000 tablets. The storage conditions require maintaining a temperature of 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F), in accordance with USP Controlled Room Temperature guidelines. The bottles must be kept tightly closed and dispensed in a tight container as defined by the USP.
